title: Product Listing & Add to Bag
content:
PS-002 — Product Listing & Add to Bag (Myntra Men’s T-Shirts)
Module: Product Listing Tags: regression, smoke Priority: High

Description:
Verify that a user can browse Men’s T-Shirts on Myntra, open a product, select size, and add the item to the bag successfully.

Acceptance Criteria:
* User should be able to open the Myntra website.
* User should be able to navigate to Men → T-Shirts category.
* User should be able to view the list of available T-Shirts.
* User should be able to see product name, price, and image for each item.
* User should be able to click on the first product in the listing.
* User should be redirected to the product detail page.
* User should be able to view product details (name, price, images, size options).
* User should be able to select a valid size (e.g., S/M/L/XL depending on availability).
* User should be able to click on “Add to Bag” button.
* User should be able to see confirmation that the item is added to the bag.
* User should be able to see the bag/cart icon updated with item count.
* User should be able to open the bag and verify the selected product is present.

Test Data:
* url: https://www.myntra.com/
* category: Men’s T-Shirts
* productSelection: First product in listing
* size: Any available valid size (e.g., M or L)
* action: Add to Bag
